title: File:Berlin UBI march (48962533408).jpg
desc: Organizer Stefan Perlebach speaks to a crowd in Berlin. Approximately 150 to 200 people marched in the German capital on October 26, 2019, in support of universal basic income, walking from Alexanderplatz to the Brandenburg Gate. Thousands of other people marched in more than 20 cities worldwide.
